resources.string: Official Hawkeye builds are published by the Dronecode Foundation, on Google Play and at github.com/PX4/Hawkeye, and are signed with keys the foundation holds. Builds obtained anywhere else are unofficial and are not supported by the Hawkeye project.

Hawkeye is a visualization and analysis tool. It is not a flight-safety device and is not certified for operational use. Do not make flight decisions based on what it displays. The software is provided \"AS IS\", without warranty of any kind.

Hawkeye collects no personal data. Your flight logs and settings stay on this device, and backup to cloud storage is disabled. Crash reports are sent so faults can be fixed; they never include your logs, and you can turn them off in Settings.
